hints: Resolve forces along the direction of the rod: $F\cos\theta = 7.5\cos 60^\circ + 4.5\cos 20^\circ$.
Resolve forces perpendicular to the rod: $F\sin\theta = 7.5\sin 60^\circ - 4.5\sin 20^\circ$.
Divide the two equations to find $\tan\theta = \frac{4.9561}{7.9786}$ and solve for $\theta$.
walkthrough:
Set up the equilibrium condition along the rod ($x$-axis):
$$\Sigma F_x = 0 \implies F\cos\theta - 7.5\cos 60^\circ - 4.5\cos 20^\circ = 0$$
$$F\cos\theta = 7.5\cos 60^\circ + 4.5\cos 20^\circ$$
Calculate the numerical components:
$$7.5\cos 60^\circ = 7.5 \times 0.5 = 3.75\text{ N}$$
$$4.5\cos 20^\circ = 4.5 \times 0.9396926 = 4.22862\text{ N}$$
$$F\cos\theta = 3.75 + 4.22862 = 7.97862\text{ N} \quad \text{[Equation 1]}$$

Set up the equilibrium condition perpendicular to the rod ($y$-axis):
$$\Sigma F_y = 0 \implies F\sin\theta - 7.5\sin 60^\circ + 4.5\sin 20^\circ = 0$$
$$F\sin\theta = 7.5\sin 60^\circ - 4.5\sin 20^\circ$$
Calculate the numerical components:
$$7.5\sin 60^\circ = 7.5 \times 0.8660254 = 6.49519\text{ N}$$
$$4.5\sin 20^\circ = 4.5 \times 0.3420201 = 1.53909\text{ N}$$
$$F\sin\theta = 6.49519 - 1.53909 = 4.95610\text{ N} \quad \text{[Equation 2]}$$

Solve for $\theta$ by dividing Equation 2 by Equation 1:
$$\frac{F\sin\theta}{F\cos\theta} = \tan\theta = \frac{4.95610}{7.97862} \approx 0.621173$$
$$\theta = \arctan(0.621173) \approx 31.844^\circ$$
Rounding to 1 decimal place gives $\theta = 31.8^\circ$.

Solve for $F$ by summing the squares of Equation 1 and Equation 2:
$$F^2 = (F\cos\theta)^2 + (F\sin\theta)^2 = (7.97862)^2 + (4.95610)^2$$
$$F^2 = 63.65838 + 24.56293 = 88.22131$$
$$F = \sqrt{88.22131} \approx 9.39262\text{ N}$$
Rounding to 3 significant figures gives $F = 9.39\text{ N}$.

hints: The ring accelerates along the horizontal rod $AB$, so resolve forces in this direction.
Write Newton's second law along the rod: $F\cos 30^\circ - 7.5\cos 60^\circ - 4.5\cos 20^\circ = ma$.
Substitute $F = 9.5\text{ N}$ and $a = 1.5\text{ m s}^{-2}$, then solve for $m$.
walkthrough:
State Newton's second law along the axis of the rod $AB$:
$$F_{\text{net}} = ma$$
$$F\cos\theta - 7.5\cos 60^\circ - 4.5\cos 20^\circ = ma$$

Substitute the given numerical parameters $F = 9.5\text{ N}$, $\theta = 30^\circ$, and $a = 1.5\text{ m s}^{-2}$:
$$9.5\cos 30^\circ - 7.5\cos 60^\circ - 4.5\cos 20^\circ = 1.5m$$
Calculate each trigonometric term:
$$9.5\cos 30^\circ = 9.5 \times 0.8660254 = 8.22724\text{ N}$$
$$7.5\cos 60^\circ = 7.5 \times 0.5 = 3.75000\text{ N}$$
$$4.5\cos 20^\circ = 4.5 \times 0.9396926 = 4.22862\text{ N}$$
Calculate the resultant force:
$$F_{\text{net}} = 8.22724 - 3.75000 - 4.22862 = 0.24862\text{ N}$$

Solve for the mass $m$:
$$1.5m = 0.24862$$
$$m = \frac{0.24862}{1.5} \approx 0.16575\text{ kg}$$
Rounding to 3 significant figures gives $m = 0.166\text{ kg}$.
